text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: New Year's Day of Inari One's Classic Year—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Invited by Inari One, I had come to the beach with her friends to watch the first sunrise of the year...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrr~~~~)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh dear.
Perhaps because I woke up early, I've gotten a little hungry..."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha!
Right from the start of the new year, Oguri never changes!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ I made some onigiri, so
let's eat them together later, okay? There's
warm miso soup in the thermos too~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Is that true...!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oguri's being Oguri, and Creek's no different...
...Well, it's almost time, so sorry, but bear with it just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, watching the first sunrise of the year
together with everyone like this
is really quite exciting, isn't it?♪"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, right?
In a way, this is like
its own special New Year's festival!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...This air as night turns into morning...
It feels kind of like being in the starting gate
right before a race begins."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, true that!
That whole 'on the edge of your seat' feeling definitely has something in common with this!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops, it's finally time!
Here comes Mr. Sun!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Heheh.
Not a cloud in the sky—a beautiful first sunrise
fit for kicking off our Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It truly cleanses the soul...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...It's the start of a new year.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
âKeep your eyes on us, Mr. Sun!
'Cause this year, we're kicking off a festival
that won't bore you for a second!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Creek, Oguri.
Thanks for keeping me company today.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Not at all~♪ Being able to watch the first sunrise
of the year with Inari-chan and the others
got me all fired up too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Inari, you're forging your own path in the Classic year too, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Our target races might be different,
but there's a chance we might end up
competing along the way.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Let's both do our best this year.
And if we get the chance to race,
let's give it everything we've got.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
Let's both hype up the Twinkle Series
in our own ways!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Boss.
Thanks for taggin' along with me right at the start of the new year.
choice_data_list: Do you come to watch the first sunrise every year?
Do you come to watch the first sunrise every year?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Sis.
Thanks for tagging along with me right at the start of the new year.
choice_data_list: Do you come to watch the first sunrise every year?
Do you come to watch the first sunrise every year?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Not that it's an annual thing, but hey,
I really wanted to liven things up this year!
I just figured it'd be great to watch it together with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that we've seen the first sunrise of the year
and got ourselves all fired up,
let's head on back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, close one!
Heheh, I almost forgot the most important part.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Once again, Boss. Let's make this another great year!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Once again, Boss. Let's make this another great year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After returning to the academy and parting ways with Oguri Cap and the others,
we changed our clothes and arranged to meet up with Inari One in the Trainer's room—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
――Alright! Since we're spending New Year's Day
face-to-face like this, Guv,
why don't we do something New Year's-y?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
――Alright! Since we're spending New Year's Day
face-to-face like this, Boss,
why don't we do something New Year's-y?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gotta live it up big with every season!
That's what I call a stylish way to stir up excitement!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thinking that made sense, the New Year's activity that came to mind was—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, full of energy right from New Year's Day, huh? Good on ya.
Just so you know, I'm tough to beat in all of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Spinning tops, hanetsuki, kite-flying, and karuta!
I've been thoroughly trained in every single one of 'em by the folks back home!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, though I was made painfully aware of Inari One's true skills, we were able to spend a fun time playing New Year's games—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! That certainly feels like
New Year's too! Boss, are you by any chance
the type to spend New Year's sleeping all day?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! That certainly feels like
New Year's too! Big Sis, are you by any chance
the type to spend New Year's sleeping all day?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, some folks back home just sent over some mikan, so how about we take it easy and snack on those!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Inari One and I relaxed under the kotatsu, eating mikan, chatting about nothing in particular, and spending some quiet time together—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, New Year's shrine visit sounds great!
After greeting the sun, gotta make sure
we give our proper greetings to the gods too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right, now that it's decided, there's no time like the present!
Let's hurry to the shrine, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right, now that it's decided, there's no time like the present!
Let's hurry to the shrine, Sis!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, I went on Hatsumode with Inari One, praying for success in the Classic year—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, at the first training session of the new year—

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: —Inari One-san and the others are here!

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to bother you while you're busy!
Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oho? What's all this now?
You doing an interview on me or something?

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: Inari One, you've shown a magnificent performance since transferring from Ohi! Tell us straight, what kind of challenge will you be taking on in the Classic Year?!

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text: There's also been plenty of debate among the fans over whether turf or dirt should be her main battlefield going forward――

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I see, so what you reporters wanna hear about
is what my next move's gonna be!
Well, that makes things simple.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Lady Inari's next major goal is none other than
the Japan Dirt Derby, y'hear?!

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Wait, the "Japan Dirt Derby"!?
You mean THAT "Japan Dirt Derby"
at Oi Racecourse!?

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text: Does this mean her main battleground won't be the JRA?! Or perhaps a declaration that she's committing exclusively to dirt—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Get outta here!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Babbling on ain't stylish.
Sorry, but you'll just have to watch
how I run in the race!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Alright then, we've got training to do, so we'll be taking our leave! Reporters, thanks for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get moving, Boss. I'm itching
to get my body moving already!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get moving, Sis. I'm itching
to get my body moving already!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Loudly declaring our goals, the Classic year with Inari One begins—!!
